The '''Grand Inquisitor''',<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]</ref> also known as the '''head Inquisitor''',<ref name="Underworld">[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]</ref> or alternatively spelt '''Head Inquisitor''',<ref name="Against the Empire">[[The Last of the Jedi: Against the Empire]]</ref> and also referred to as the '''head of the Imperial Inquisitors''', was the leader of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]],<ref name="Death on Naboo">[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]</ref> a branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] consisting of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users who worked at the command of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself.<ref name="DSS" />

==Overview==
When time permitted, the Grand Inquisitor would order his subordinates to search the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users. They also had the final say on whether a new candidate was given an audience to Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="DSS">[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]</ref>

The first person known to serve in the position was head Inquisitor [[Malorum]].<ref name="Death on Naboo" /> [[Hydra (Grand Inquisitor)|Hydra]] later succeeded Malorum,<ref name="Secret Weapon">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref> while [[Ferus Olin]] temporarily took the position during his mission to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] with Hydra.<ref name="Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref> Hydra reclaimed the position after the mission<ref name="Reckoning">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''</ref> when Ferus Olin was promoted to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] second-in-command.<ref name="Master of Deception" /> Later [[Laddinare Torbin]] took up the position before [[Death/Legends|dying]] on [[Weerden]].<ref name="TSWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> Taking over between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] the position of Grand Inquisitor was taken up by [[Ja'ce Yiaso]].<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref><ref name="Yiaso's Reign">''[[Star Wars: Galaxies]] features [[Ja'ce Yiaso]] as Grand Inquisitor. Characters appear in Galaxies which die or have knowledge that occur at different years, which makes the specific timeline of Galaxies difficult to decipher. However, it can be determined that the game as a whole takes place over the course of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] as the title crawl for Galaxies establishes that the game takes place after [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|A New Hope]], saying it takes place at the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] is present on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], meaning that he can't be in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] yet, which occurred in 3 ABY according to the [[The New Essential Chronology|New Essential Chronology]]. This means that Ja'ce Yiaso was Grand Inquisitor by 1 ABY, [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], or 3 ABY.</ref>

==Known Grand Inquisitors==
*[[Malorum]]: [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Malorum's Reign">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]] establishes Malorum as head Inquisitor. [[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]] establishes that head Inquisitor and Grand Inquisitor are the same with Ferus referring to Malorum as the "head of the Imperial Inquisitors." Head Inquisitor and Grand Inquisitor being one is further reaffirmed to be the same position when used interchangeably in [[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]. Death on Naboo also establishes that it takes place six months after Senator Amidala's funeral. [[The New Essential Chronology]] dates [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|Revenge of the Sith]] to occur in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] meaning that Malorum must've been Grand Inquisitor in 19 BBY.</ref>
*[[Hydra (Grand Inquisitor)|Hydra]]: [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]<ref name="Secret Weapon" />
*[[Ferus Olin]]: 18 BBY<ref name="Ferus's Reign">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]] establishes Ferus as Head Inquisitor. [[The Essential Reader's Companion]] dates Master of Deception to [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref>
*Hydra: 18 BBY&mdash;c. [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]<ref name="Hydra's Reign">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]] reestablishes Hydra as Head Inquisitor. [[The Essential Reader's Companion]] dates Reckoning to [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. According to [[The Emperor's Pawns]] Grand Inquisitor [[Laddinare Torbin]] faced [[Arden Lyn]] and cleaved off her arm after she reawoke. [[The Essential Guide to Warfare]] establishes that Lyn reawoke in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]] meaning that Torbin had to have taken over as Grand Inquisitor by then.''</ref>
*[[Laddinare Torbin]]: By 4 BBY&mdash;c. [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="Torbin's Reign">''[[The Emperor's Pawns]] claims that [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] Torbin cleaved off [[Arden Lyn|Arden Lyn's]] arm after her reawakening. [[The Essential Guide to Warfare]] establishes that Lyn reawoke in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], meaning he must've been Grand Inquisitor by 4 BBY. However, that also doubles as the earliest point for his death, as [[Star Wars: Galaxies]] features a new Grand Inquisitor, [[Ja'ce Yiaso]]. Characters appear in Galaxies which die or have knowledge that occur at different years, which makes the specific timeline of Galaxies difficult to decipher. However, it can be determined that the game as a whole takes place over the course of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] as the title crawl for Galaxies establishes that the game takes place after [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|A New Hope]], saying it takes place at the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] is present on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], meaning that he can't be in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] yet, which occurred in 3 ABY according to the [[The New Essential Chronology|New Essential Chronology]] Meaning that Torbin died between 4 BBY and 3 ABY.</ref>
*[[Ja'ce Yiaso]]: by c. [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] or 3 ABY&mdash;<ref name="Yiaso's Reign" />
